description: Implementation of an in-memory mock backend API for notes, providing methods to push and fetch notes with last-write-wins behavior based on updatedAt timestamp.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesApi
classes.description: A mock backend implementing NotesApi interface that stores notes in memory and updates based on last modified timestamp.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Saves a list of notes into the store, replacing existing entries if incoming note's updatedAt is newer or equal.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Retrieves notes updated after a given timestamp, sorted by most recent update.
